name: Security and Trust
meta_description: Learn about MASAR's approach to data protection, access management, verification and oversight, and what to know before using financial services.
body:
# Trust starts with what you know about the service.
We are preparing MASAR's services with data protection, access management and operational oversight in mind, alongside clear customer information about each product and its provider.

## Data protection and access
Our design approach focuses on who needs data and why, limiting unnecessary access and considering information protection during collection, processing and sharing.

## Verification appropriate to the service
Financial products may require verification of a customer's or business's identity and authority to use the service. Requirements and approved channels are explained before activation.

## Risk management and follow-up
Preparatory work includes organizing the review of unusual activity, limits and operational cases, and defining responsibilities and escalation procedures within the scope of approved services.

## Reconciliation and records
We prioritize clear transaction references, reconciliation and follow-up in operational design, so that events can be reviewed and discrepancies addressed in an organized way.

## Help protect your information
Do not share passwords, PINs or verification codes with anyone contacting you by phone or message. Use officially published channels to ask about an unusual request.
publishing_gate: Approve security statements against the controls actually implemented
editorial_notes: Current wording describes a design approach, not an assurance certification. Do not claim PCI DSS, ISO, SOC, specific encryption or 100% security without evidence, scope and validity dates. Do not publish fraud-detection rules or sensitive infrastructure details.

body:
# Understand the cost before you begin.
Product costs vary by service type, scope and usage. This page is intended to bring approved fee schedules and limits together in an accessible reference.

## What does a fee schedule explain?
Setup or subscription fees, if any; transaction fees; device costs where applicable; refund or dispute fees where applicable; and taxes or third-party charges that must be disclosed.

## Fees are not the only consideration
The service offer also explains currencies and channels, limits, settlement frequency, cancellation and suspension terms, and the fee schedule's effective date.

## During preparation
Approved fees are announced as each service becomes available. You can contact us to discuss your needs, and approved commercial information is provided before any agreement or activation.
publishing_gate: Replace the preparation-stage paragraph only when an approved fee table is available
editorial_notes: Any editorial-version wording is replaced on the website with: Approved fees are announced as each service becomes available. No invented figures or unsupported free-of-charge or no-hidden-fees claims. Table fields: service, charging unit, amount, currency, tax, limit, exceptions and effective date.

name: Frequently Asked Questions
meta_description: Answers about MASAR, the project's stage, planned services, fees, integration, activation requirements and support.
body:
# Clear questions. Direct answers.

## What is MASAR?
MASAR is a project to develop payment and digital financial solutions for individuals, merchants, companies and institutions, within the Masar Global for Financial Systems and Solutions company project.

## Is MASAR a bank?
This website does not present MASAR as a bank. The nature of each product and the organization providing or issuing it are explained in its approved documentation.

## Does preliminary approval authorize business operations?
The Central Bank of Yemen letter dated September 13, 2026 states that preliminary approval does not authorize the commencement of business and that final approval is subject to fulfillment of the specified requirements.

## Are all the solutions shown available now?
The website presents areas of work under preparation. Each service's availability is announced after approval; appearing in the solutions section does not mean a service is open for activation.

## What is the difference between point of sale and a payment gateway?
Point-of-sale solutions serve payments at a sales location, while a payment gateway serves payments on websites and apps. A business may need both channels.

## Are bulk payments only for payroll?
The planned scope includes payroll, supplier payments, commissions and multi-recipient disbursement programs, subject to the approved service scope.

## Which payment methods and currencies are supported?
These are defined in each product's documentation when it becomes available. Product information explains the payment methods and currencies that can actually be used.

## Is there an ATM or service-point network I can use?
Refer to the approved location directory when it is published. An introductory description of cash services does not establish that a network is operational.

## What are the fees and settlement times?
They are announced in the service-specific fee schedule and terms. A single fee or timetable cannot be assumed for all products.

## Which documents are required?
Requirements vary by product and customer category. Your first inquiry does not require an ID document or bank statement; verification documents are requested later through designated channels when needed.

## Does registering my details on the website activate a financial service?
No. Submitting an inquiry or expressing interest does not open a financial account, issue a card or activate a payment service.

## Can we connect our system to MASAR?
You can discuss your requirements with us. Implementation depends on product and documentation availability, integration scope and required testing.

## Where can I find API documentation?
Official references for integrable services are published when approved. The introductory developer page is not a substitute for usable technical documentation.

## How do I submit feedback or a complaint?
Use the approved contact or complaints channel once activated. Keep your request reference, and do not send passwords, verification codes or full card details.
publishing_gate: Editorial and compliance review before publication
editorial_notes: Update availability, pricing and documentation answers from a central register as products go live. The complaints answer assumes only a real channel is displayed. The company name is rendered in working English, not asserted as a registered English legal name.

name: Complaints and Customer Protection
meta_description: Learn how to submit feedback or a complaint to MASAR, what information supports follow-up and how review and escalation work once procedures are approved.
body:
# Your concern deserves a clear review.
We are preparing a complaints process distinct from commercial inquiries: describing what happened, reviewing the facts and providing a clear outcome that can be referred to later.

## What helps the review?
Your name and contact details, the relevant service, a description and date of the issue, and a transaction or request reference if available. Attach only necessary documents, after concealing information unrelated to the complaint.

## How is a complaint reviewed?
The complaint is received and assigned a reference, then reviewed, with missing information requested where needed. The complainant is then informed of the outcome, action taken or appropriate explanation.

## Reconsideration and escalation
The approved policy explains how to request a further review, who handles it, relevant timeframes and available escalation routes for the service type. These details are published before the product's complaints channel becomes operational.

## Information we do not need in a complaint
Do not send a password, PIN, verification code or a full image of your card. Sensitive attachments must go through an approved channel, not public comments.
cta: Submit a complaint → Approved working form only
publishing_gate: Operational draft; do not publish as a commitment before the process, channel and timeframes are approved
editorial_notes: Approval needed: receiving channels, tracking reference, acknowledgment and resolution timeframes, exceptions, reopening and escalation, and attachment retention. References to a proposed process are internal and removed only after the process is approved.

name: Stay Safe
seo_title: Protect Your Information and Payments | MASAR
meta_description: Practical guidance on suspicious messages and links, protecting passwords and verification codes, and handling unusual payment requests.
body:
# Pause before acting on a request about your money or data.
A message may seem convincing or urgent, but verifying its source matters more than replying quickly.

## Keep your security codes private
Do not share a password, PIN or verification code with someone contacting you by phone or message. Enter verification details only through the official channel and after checking the transaction you are authorizing.

## Open the official channel yourself
If you are unsure about a link, do not open it from the message. Go directly to the official website or app, then verify the request using the contact details published there.

## Recipient details changed? Check first.
Confirm directly with the person making the request through a trusted contact method you have used before, especially if you are asked to transfer money to a new account.

## An image is not always confirmation
When receiving a payment, check its status in your system or with the authorized provider. Do not rely solely on a screenshot of a message or an unverifiable receipt.

## Found a suspicious request?
Stop interacting, keep the message and transaction reference if available, and contact the account or card provider through its official channels. Do not delete evidence before recording it.
publishing_gate: Editorial and compliance review before publication
editorial_notes: General guidance source: Emirates NBD's fraud-awareness campaign. Do not promise payment reversal, recovery of funds or account freezing through this form. Do not say HTTPS alone proves a website is legitimate.

body:
# Every need starts with a clear conversation.
Tell us how payment solutions could help your business, or share your question about MASAR. Choose the closest topic so your request reaches the right team.

## Inquiry topic
Services and business, technical integration, partnerships, media or a general inquiry. Complaints are directed to the approved complaints process once activated.

## Contact form
Name; organization where applicable; an email address or telephone number for contact; request subject; and a short description of your needs.

## Protect your privacy
Do not attach full card or account details, passwords, verification codes or identity documents to a general inquiry. We ask only for the information needed to understand your request.

## After submission
When the request is successfully recorded: "We have received your inquiry. Keep the displayed reference number to follow up."
If submission fails: "Your request was not submitted. Check your connection and try again. Do not re-enter sensitive information."
publishing_gate: Test the form, privacy information and actual receipt before publication
editorial_notes: Do not publish telephone numbers, email addresses, addresses or hours from demo data. Display a reference only after a real record is created. Acknowledgment of the privacy notice is separate from optional marketing consent.

seo_title: Service Status and Operational Updates | MASAR
meta_description: Service status, incident and maintenance updates once monitoring and approved operational reporting are enabled for each product.
body:
# Service status from a source you can refer to.
This page displays the status of operational products covered by monitoring, along with incident and maintenance updates once enabled.

## What does each status mean?
**Operational:** Approved monitoring confirms the availability of the functions being checked.
**Partially affected:** There is a defined impact on some functions or users.
**Unavailable:** The function covered by the update cannot be used.
**Scheduled maintenance:** A planned change with an announced time and scope of impact.
**Status unknown:** No reliable recent reading is available.

## A clear record for each incident
The impact start time, affected service, known scope of the issue, latest update, action taken and verified recovery time.

## Before monitoring is enabled
The operational status page for these products is not yet active. Please contact us to ask about availability.
publishing_gate: Do not publish operational indicators before they are connected to real monitoring
editorial_notes: Railway SUCCESS does not establish payment health or bank connectivity. No invented uptime percentages, response times or maintenance history. Name the scope of the checks and distinguish website availability from financial-product availability.

# Your data deserves a clear explanation.
**Draft website notice, not a final policy or a verified description of actual processing. Complete and approve the following fields before using this text.**

## 1. Who is responsible for your data?
[Registered legal entity and address] is responsible for processing data related to this website. For privacy inquiries: [approved privacy contact channel].

## 2. Scope of this notice
This notice covers [website browsing, inquiry forms and newsletters/recruitment, according to what actually exists]. Financial products will have separate notices when operational, reflecting the product and participating organizations.

## 3. Data collected
[Actual fields in each form], [technical log data actually collected] and [cookie data following an inventory]. Do not add a data category simply because it is common on other websites.

## 4. Why is it used?
[Connect each data category to a specific purpose, such as answering inquiries, protecting the service, recruitment or optional marketing], with [the applicable legal basis identified following review].

## 5. Sharing and processing locations
[Processors, hosting or messaging providers, relevant countries, and the nature and reasons for sharing]. Website hosting does not by itself establish that all data stays in a particular country.

## 6. Retention period
[A period or retention criterion for each data category], and [deletion, anonymization or retention procedures for an applicable legal obligation].

## 7. Privacy requests
Data-related requests may be sent to [approved channel]. The requester's rights, verification method, timeframes and exceptions are determined under [applicable legal framework].

## 8. Marketing choices
[Separate consent method if marketing is used, and the unsubscribe process once enabled]. A service request must not become blanket consent for every marketing use.

## 9. Protection and updates
[Accurate description of implemented controls without an absolute guarantee]. Effective date: [approved date]. Updates are published with an explanation of changes where required.
publishing_gate: Not suitable for publication until the data register is completed and legal review is finished
editorial_notes: Do not assume GDPR, fixed periods or unverified rights apply. Connect the form to a completed notice before collecting data; a statement that privacy is respected is not sufficient.

body:
# A clearer, easier-to-use website.
We aim to provide readable content, clear navigation and an experience that considers mobile devices, keyboard use and assistive technologies.

## What are we working to improve?
Clear headings and links, text enlargement, form-field labels, contrast, error messages and reduced unnecessary motion.

## Encountered a barrier?
Tell us which page and step you could not complete, and your device or browser where helpful. Do not include sensitive information in the issue description.

## Testing statement
Test results, scope and dates are added after verification. This statement does not claim certification or a particular conformance level.
publishing_gate: Approve the improvement objective and reporting channel; do not claim conformance without testing
editorial_notes: No WCAG AA, accessibility percentage or universal compatibility claims without assessment. Do not offer an alternative support service, such as telephone assistance, unless the channel and resources exist.
